description: Compare prices across Indian retailers for a product query and return the cheapest available listing per retailer (Amazon, Flipkart, Croma, …), sorted by price. Note: this returns the cheapest listing per store for the query — not necessarily the identical SKU. Use after search_products or standalone; then render_product_results to display the offers as cards.
name: compare_prices

id.description: Opaque product id — pass through unchanged; used in buy links

lastUpdated.description: Unix seconds when the price was last seen

mrp.description: Maximum retail price in INR, when known

productPageUrl.description: PriceInIndia product page — use for citations

title: Compare prices across retailers
